name: genpark-hume-ai-empathic-voice-prosody-expression-analyzer-skill
description: Hume AI & Meta Muse-inspired Empathic Voice Prosody & Expression Analyzer. Decodes acoustic fundamental frequency (F0), speech tempo, jitter, and semantic sentiment into high-dimensional emotional states to direct real-time expressive TTS modulation.

tools.name: analyze_expression_and_modulate
tools.description: Analyze acoustic speech prosody and semantic cues to output emotional state and TTS modulation parameters.

acoustic_features.description: Acoustic signals: mean_f0_hz, f0_variance, speaking_rate_wpm, pause_ratio, jitter_local.
